review: assess-food-suitability@1 (handler long.assess-food-suitability, scope long-ex26, learning 1 with no study energy, prerequisite and dependency probe, references { target: optional-exact-visible } so that the shared resolver accepts only one exact identity the person sees now and never a resource name or a remembered location, execution duration 1, visualComponents [] with view metadata on every event, no satisfaction rule, process, beforeAction or onDeath) is the general operation assess-food-suitability(target, mode, intendedConsumer, evidenceRefs, methodRef, intensity) for any person and any accessible item or source of a material. Existing handlers were checked first: ex24 assess-food-evidence@1 (scope long-ex24, not installable here) holds the equivalent evidence evaluator, so its citation and classification (personal records with completeness, applicability and currency checks, dated eating records, heard messages, received claims) is reused unchanged through a new export foodEvidenceCite of long-ex24-food-evidence.ts (export lines only, no behavior change, so every other world stays byte-identical without a gate), together with the ex21 targeted-food-constituent-test@1 id-list and bounded-text parsers, the ex24 examine-material@1 unit-record state and digest, shelterMeasure, collectiveFoodProfile, v7Observe and v7Reach; the ex19 and ex21 air-exposure and drying trials (exposure of whole food), examine-material (traits and dimensions), the ex21 constituent test (a requirement bill without measurement) and the source-bound food evidence precursor are not equivalent. inspect calls OPEN_FOUNDATION.handlers['open.probe'] itself in observe mode (1 round, 0.2 energy, its observed-state record and events); trial calls it in press, wet or heat mode (1 round, 0.5 energy, exactly 0.1 unit of an owned sample debited once by probe and accounted as loss, not as food; heat also 0.1 available heat of a source in reach; wet needs a marsh, ford or river cell where the person stands); nothing is charged twice and no surcharge is added. One evaluator then attaches separate conclusions for identity, nutrition, toxicity and preparation, each supported, contradicted or unresolved with its claim, basis and evidence ids, an overall verdict, the cited evidence with its category, and limits, and writes one personal record <target>:food-suitability (verified false; cited again it counts as a derived report). Modeling assumptions: (1) the world shows a kind only through its shown kind and name, so a name or label never identifies; identity is supported only when the person cites their own dated eating record (the record eat keeps) of exactly the shown kind of a target in reach or carried that is not a processed lot, that is, recognition of a kind the person has handled and eaten; only then are that record's own satiety and health loss cited (a record changed to 7 is cited as 7), preparation is none for units as eaten, and harm in the record gives 'do not consume on this evidence'; berry knowledge never transfers to roots or any other kind, and undated starting knowledge is refused as incomplete by the reused citation; (2) without such evidence every food conclusion stays unresolved and the verdict is 'safety unresolved; do not consume on this evidence.'; appearance, stock and probe's visible state are not food evidence, and no hidden nutrition, toxicity or material value is read or shown (trial values are probe's own paid readings); (3) probe's load, water and heat responses measure no nutrition, harm or preparation, so a trial has a diagnostic relationship only to identity, by comparison with a cited verified probe record of the same kind, method, condition and load: a different response at the world's shared numeric precision contradicts identity (view status informative-failure) and a match identifies nothing; without such a record, an owned sample of at least 0.1 unit, the heat source or water, or the energy, the trial is refused before any cost, naming each missing prerequisite and the debit; no taste test, ingestion, feeding, new measurement, preparation or detoxification mechanism is added or silently granted, and this world has no heat source, so heat trials are refused; (4) intendedConsumer is the actor by default or a living person the actor sees now; only the actor's own records are used, nothing of the other person's state or records is read or shown, they are neither asked nor committed, and anyone not seen is refused with the same words as an unknown id; (5) refusals cost nothing: no target, a target not seen now (including one only remembered or named), out of reach, another person's item, an animal or anything without a material, unknown or incomplete record ids, more than 6 ids, a methodRef that is not one of probe's methods, too little energy; (6) each round is atomic: a refused or interrupted round (a computation pause after the action is tested) commits nothing, and a retry is a new paid round; death after commitment keeps the debit, the loss accounting and the record, and nothing is pending, refunded or continued; (7) no reward: no satisfaction rule or trigger (the confirmed-understanding source stays keyed to probe), no practice milestone (neither event carries a qualified flag), and open-experience.ts counts the interface as a probe round only where this revision is installed, so routine and experience match probing by hand; (8) the operation never moves anyone and reports nothing beyond the target in reach and the person's own records. In the archived round-102 world Kai sees only three canopy trees, none in reach, carries nothing and has a dated berry eating record from round 41, so remembered roots are refused at no cost; he can study the operation in one round and use it once a root or berry source is within reach or a unit is carried, and for roots safety stays unresolved for him until he has evidence of his own. long-ex26-tend-plants.test.ts now asserts that its package is third for long-ex26 instead of last.
